insight: A chat-first money app whose AI deliberately adopts a sarcastic "roast me" persona to nudge spending, unlike straight-laced budgeting tools.
name: Cleo
tagline: Chat-first AI money assistant for budgeting and saving.
description: Cleo is a consumer personal-finance app you text like a friend to ask about spending, set budgets, and get savings nudges. Its AI categorizes transactions automatically via a Plaid bank connection and surfaces personalized tips, with optional cash-advance and round-up savings features. Known for a playful, sometimes sarcastic chat persona.

modelSupport.notes: Conversational AI assistant over the user's connected bank data.
